verdict.rationale: Wise's API lets developers retrieve balance statements in accounting-friendly formats (JSON, CSV, PDF, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF) and pull card transaction data, which covers the 'view' side of accounting data. There is no evidence of a dedicated accounting API for managing that data, such as editing records, categorization or ledger sync, so this amounts to bank-data export rather than accounting management. Missing for 10: a dedicated accounting/ledger API, write or manage operations on accounting records, documented accounting-software integrations, and independent hands-on corroboration.
